items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: And who was on third? Dubny. He was playing third. You were playing third.

ctx.x: I see, because things do make a difference that way.
So who was the real toucher when you first came here? Arthur Dubny, political trauma, three weeks.
And who was on third? Dubny. He was playing third. You were playing third. And then Matt Raichner would be playing...
